items.title: Joe Robichaux Interview, 1959-03-19
items.q: I had Van Dyke, had Freddie Colman, drummer, Willie O'Connor. I had Jeff, Sam Dutre, Clemens Tivallon, Warren Joseph, which we call Frog.

ctx.x: He was in good form then when you heard him.

Yeah, when I heard him play, he was actually good. He was really good because I had heard a lot of good trumpet players and all the trumpet players that they were talking about were good during those times. And I don't think they had anybody any better than him, I'll tell you that. Because he really played. And then after I met him then, then I came to New Orleans and played around here quite a while at the Music Box that was at Canal and Crown Lamp. And I played at the La Vida with Lee Collins and David Jones.…
George Girard, is that the white trumpet player?
